query:
SELECT t.id, t.name
                 FROM tags t
                WHERE EXISTS (
                          SELECT 1 FROM manifestation_tags mt
                          JOIN manifestations m ON m.id = mt.manifestation_id
                         WHERE mt.tag_id = t.id
                      )
                  AND (t.name ILIKE $1 || '%' OR $2 <% t.name)
                ORDER BY (t.name ILIKE $1 || '%') DESC,
                         word_similarity($2, t.name) DESC,
                         t.name ASC
                LIMIT $3
